acceptance_predicates.description: The runner captures and seals a selected workload cassette from a generated plan.
Replay consumes the exact cassette digest with network/provider contact denied.
Reopen, interruption, cleanup, and idempotency behavior are bounded and typed.
Runner, provider/model, generation, workload, plan, and cassette identities are cross-checked.

definition_of_done: Exact-head capture/replay receipt and negative matrix are recorded.
Independent review, hosted checks, generated projections, and no-secret scan pass.

inputs.description: Existing ASB capture and cassette lifecycle contracts.

outputs.description: Runner-owned capture, seal, reopen, and strict replay receipt.

gates.description: Strict replay passes with provider/network contact denied.
Every replay artifact is bound to the exact generated plan and cassette digest.
